theme_revenue_exposure.basis: No Cook-Islands- or CIC/OML-specific revenue percentage is disclosed or sourced; Odyssey's stakes are minority equity investments and an option, not a reported operating segment, matching the sourced profile's exposure_summary.

earnings_nuggets.quote: Odyssey has the right, but not the obligation, to purchase from each CIC Option Stockholder all or a portion of the CIC Shares held by such CIC Option Stockholder
earnings_nuggets.basis: Q2 2026 10-Q, fetched via a September 2026 prices/fundamentals/quality/edgar_doc request batch for OMEX. Directly evidences Odyssey's ccz-nodule-resource placement: the CIC Limited Option Agreement is the disclosed mechanism behind the mapping placement's claim of an equity investment in CIC Limited, one of the two named Cook Islands license holders.
